title: Warning?
body:
Hey everyone. I'll be honest I'm new with this RayHunter and don't know how to read the logs. But I can tell you that I have a very good reason to have it and I need to make sure it's working properly and on the main screen of the RayHunter UI it says 0 warnings but when I open the log I'm getting these Warnings:

R A Y H U N T E R 🐳
[2026-06-23T23:57:51Z INFO  rayhunter_daemon] Using configuration for device: Orbic
[2026-06-23T23:57:51Z INFO  rayhunter::diag_device] Diag device initialization succeeded after 0 retries
[2026-06-23T23:57:51Z INFO  rayhunter::diag_device] retrieving diag logging capabilities...
[2026-06-23T23:57:51Z WARN  rayhunter::diag] warning: 329 leftover bytes when parsing Message
[2026-06-23T23:57:51Z INFO  rayhunter::diag_device] enabled logging for log type 1
[2026-06-23T23:57:51Z WARN  rayhunter::diag] warning: 298 leftover bytes when parsing Message
[2026-06-23T23:57:51Z INFO  rayhunter::diag_device] enabled logging for log type 4
[2026-06-23T23:57:51Z WARN  rayhunter::diag] warning: 140 leftover bytes when parsing Message
[2026-06-23T23:57:51Z INFO  rayhunter::diag_device] enabled logging for log type 5

Is this an actual warning? Should I be concerned? And is there any other anti surveillance tools or gadgets anyone can recommend to stay one step ahead of the police. Thanks in advance 🍻
